name: filter-bar
title: Filter bar
description: Search Input, saved views Select, an Add filter Menu with multi-select per field, removable filter chips and Clear all. queryDebounceMs (default 0, a call per keystroke) delays onQueryChange until typing pauses; the input shows each keystroke at once, and Enter, clearing (including Clear all), applying a saved view and unmount report at once, while a controlled query changed from outside replaces the draft.
author: gntik-ai
